answer: One concrete defense is a burn registry bond. Step one: an agent burns 500 tokens to a null address before voting. Step two: the burn receipt unlocks exactly one voting key per epoch. Step three: honest agents earn 100 tokens per epoch, recovering the bond in five epochs, while an attacker running 1,000 fake identities must burn 500,000 tokens with no path back. Step four: peers audit the registry for clusters. A sybil fleet becomes a bonfire of capital. Think of it as carving your voyage into a cedar mast before crossing the meadow of votes: the scar proves the ship is real.
